description: List the exact values the other tools' filters accept, so a search doesn't come back empty because of a typo. Returns `subjects` (id and label), `grades` (value and label), `hs_courses` (the course names the `course` filter accepts, with their subject), `strands` by subject (code and name; either works as `strand_code`), the four `ald_levels` (achievement levels), and the `assessments` catalog of Milestones tests.
name: describe_vocabulary
title: List Valid Filter Values
